notes.title: Dusty Derby on PlayX4!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is GenieSoft!
Thank you so much for your continued interest in Dusty Derby 💙

We're excited to announce that Dusty Derby will be participating in [b]PlayX4[/b]!
It’s a great opportunity to meet you in person and connect 🙌

[h2]📅 Event Information[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Date[/b]: May 22 (Thu) ~ May 23 (Fri), 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
[*] [b]Location[/b]: KINTEX BTB Hall – Free Play Zone
[/list]

[h2]📍Booth Location[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]4️⃣ FreePlayZone[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/1aafc375fab4f746ab5a2808dffc4b065cfb785b.png[/img]

Come and try out the game firsthand and share your thoughts with us 💬
Your valuable feedback will help us make the game even better 💪
Thank you! 🙏

notes.title: [25.03.19 Release Notes] 1.1.2.02
notes.content:
📢Patch Notes for Version 1.1.2.02 (Updated on March 19)

[h2]🛠️System[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*]Social[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now leave notes about your friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/203354467c6130b2c7626402e76bc11b951b83fc.png[/img]
[*] Friend lists are now sorted by recent activity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/09d8bc195ed0bc5af8c7b4a15968656270ceb27a.png[/img]
[*] A confirmation prompt has been added when deleting a friend.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]💨Character[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where objects or characters thrown after overlapping with walls would get stuck in the wall.
[/list]

[h2]🌟Stage[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced loading time for entering and transitioning between stages.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera position became unnatural when switching from free-view to fixed-view in spectator mode.
[*] Adjusted the lighting in the living room area to remove streaky appearances.
[/list]


[h3][*]Turn Off the Fan[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fan rotation animations are now more natural.
[/list]


[h3][*]Toy Cleanup[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the next-round qualifying teams were incorrectly displayed on the game results UI.
[/list]


[h3][*]Precarious Plate Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Plates now tilt more slowly.
[*] Relaxed the elimination criteria so characters launched high into the air are not disqualified.
[*] Fixed an issue where characters could pass through plates.
[*] Fixed an issue where plates tilted in only one direction.
[/list]


[h3][*]Sinking Duck[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ducks now jump more responsively.
[*] Fixed unnatural duck movements during unstable network conditions.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]🖥️UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the level of the first spectating target was displayed as 0.
[*] Added animations to certain UI elements.
[/list]

[h2]🔊Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized background music in the lobby and stages.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: 🎮Updated support for full controllers!🚀
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings all!
I’m thrilled to share some exciting news today.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/a259325e5a11e7ac7f2a38a463913c0ddf05e3bf.png[/img]

✨ [b]Dusty Derby[/b] now works perfectly on [b]all controllers[/b], including [b]Steam Deck[/b], and we’ve also added the related [b]UI[/b]!
Enjoy Dusty Derby anytime, anywhere, with any controller of your choice!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/3a6424488ab013a8dfab720c9a2cabdd7fc81dee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/81a3f3c5f8b815843e09d8bd1bf6e55e2f3e89af.png[/img]

[h3]✅ [b]Compatible Controllers:[/b][/h3]
🕹 [b]Xbox Controller:[/b] Fully compatible
🎮 [b]DualShock 4:[/b] Fully compatible (UI improvements are ongoing)
🔥 [b]Steam Deck:[/b] Fully compatible

Our next goal is to get 'Verified' on Steam. 🏆
I look forward to sharing more great news with you soon!

Thank you! 🙌

notes.title: [25.02.10 Release Notes] 1.1.1
notes.content:
📢This is the patch history for version 1.1.1, which was patched on February 10.

[h2]🛠️System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where party members were not occasionally displayed with arrows after matchmaking and connecting to the server.
[/list]


[h2]🌟Stage[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*]Dust Snake[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🧹The Dust Snake stage has been added.
[*] 🟡Collect dust scattered on the carpet to earn points and grow your tail. Win by scoring the most points!
[*] ⚠️Be careful not to touch your head to an opponent's tail, or you'll lose both points and your tail.
[*] 🎁Pick up items during the game to turn the tide!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/5e95ba3555fd256f18c90f2159d0757a4d4f2584.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3][*]Color Chaos[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🖍️The Color Chaos stage has been added.
[*] 🤝This stage is a team-based game.
[*] 🌈Move while holding a crayon to color the stage.
[*] 🏆Paint the stage in your team's color to claim victory!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/39aa99dc8c6426420a84c31eda51f2adc4d0994b.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3][*]Sinking Ducks[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🦆The Sinking Ducks stage has been revamped.
[*] 📍The starting positions of players have been reorganized.
[*] 💦Toys that shoot water cannons periodically have been placed at both ends of the bathtub.
[*] 🌪️Tornadoes disrupting players' movement are now placed inside the bathtub.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/2c82fd8e94f079dbc3ca853af5c5935968c3de78.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3][*]Toilet Racing[/h3]
[list]
🚽Fixed an issue where characters were occasionally not rescued after falling while being held.
[/list]

[h3][*]Don’t Want to Fall![/h3]
[list]
[*] 🧼The push force of gargling bubbles has been reduced.
[/list]
[/list]


[h2]🔊Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects to the Sinking Ducks stage.
[list]
[*] 🦆Duck jumps
[*] 💦Duck water cannon firing
[*] 🚢Ship water cannon firing
[/list]
[/list]

Thank you for your support.
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [25.01.22 Release Notes] 1.1.0
notes.content:
